title: Instructions for the priestly garments
description: God gives Moses detailed instructions about the sacred garments for Aaron and his sons: the ephod with two onyx stones bearing the names of the tribes of Israel, the breastpiece with twelve precious stones and the Urim and Thummim, the robe with pomegranates and golden bells, the tunic and the turban, as well as the gold plate inscribed with "Holy to the Lord." The garments are to bring honor and splendor to the priestly service.
